# The barista's own overall call: "healthy (36g within healthy zone) and
# tasted balanced" - the real weight trace does cross target_yield_g
# (36.0g) at elapsed_ms=26048, which genuinely falls inside the chart's
# own healthy time window ([24795, 30994]ms for this shot). Yet this is
# recorded/classified too_fast (duration_ratio=0.843, just under the
# healthy band's own 0.88 lower edge) - NOT a misclassification bug, but
# two compounding, already-understood limitations landing on the same
# real shot:
#   1. (dominant) This bag had no per-bag baseline yet
#      (baseline_eligible=false), so expected_flow_g_s fell back to the
#      generic global/roast-level prior (1.7 g/s) rather than this bag's
#      own apparently-faster characteristic pace (mid_flow_g_s=2.198
#      g/s here) - see flow_analysis.py's module docstring on Bayesian
#      shrinkage. Recomputing duration_ratio with a prior matching this
#      bag's real pace instead lands at ~1.02 - squarely healthy.
#   2. (secondary) Classification is driven by t_90 (time to 90% of
#      target, 32.4g - reached at elapsed_ms=23755, 1.04s before the
#      too_fast cutoff), not by when the trace actually reaches 100% of
#      target (which is what the chart's own healthy window visualizes).
#      This shot's flow decelerated hard late (late_flow_g_s=0.884 g/s
#      vs mid_flow_g_s=2.198 g/s), so the last 10% took proportionally
#      longer than the constant-rate assumption behind projecting a t_90
#      crossing out to an implied 100%-of-target time - see
#      analyze_shot's own "Open caveat" comment on real flow not being
#      constant across a pour.
# channeling_suspicion (0.086) is well under suspicion_threshold (0.6),
# so no puck-prep concern either. Kept as a real example of "too_fast"
# (a timing-vs-generic-prior signal, further muddied by late-shot
# deceleration) not implying something is actually wrong with the shot -
# the mirror image of healthy_astringent_adapt_pi.txt's "healthy by
# timing, tasted bad" case. recommended_grind_delta=-0.5 is the system's
# own intended self-correction (grind finer next time) - not something
# this fixture's tests need to second-guess.
# Sample columns: seq	elapsed_ms	scale_ms	weight_g	flow_g_s	battery_percent	post_stop
# post_stop=1 means the sample was recorded after the stop command.
